overall_summary: Deduplication reveals 47 unique videos across September and October 2026. The clear outperformer is the immersive second-person space survival angle ('What If You Fell Into...'), routinely generating 800 to 1,050+ views and 15 to 38 likes per video (e.g., Liquid Diamond Planet, Darkest Planet, Burning Ice). In contrast, generic psychology trivia ('fake memories', 'songs stuck in your head') and repeated re-uploads catastrophically underperform (single-digit to low double-digit views). Growth relies on high-stakes, visceral physical consequences in extreme cosmic environments.

winning_patterns.pattern: Second-Person Extreme Planet Infiltration ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes), 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes), and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (824 views, 15 likes) dominate the top tier.
winning_patterns.action: Adopt the sensory, high-stakes 'What If You Fell Into...' narrative framework for extreme physical and astronomical phenomena.

winning_patterns.pattern: Paradoxical Cosmic Headlines with Clear Extremes
winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (1,031 views, 36 likes) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) generated near 1,000 views with high like-to-view ratios (~3.5%).
winning_patterns.action: Frame space hooks around stark cognitive contradictions or absolute planetary superlatives.

weak_patterns.evidence: Multiple variations of 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' flatlined at 5 to 53 views, and earworm psychology videos stalled at 17 to 71 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pause generic psychology facts unless framed as high-stakes survival or dark psychological anomalies.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeatedly publishing identical titles/concepts like 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' (34-220 views) or 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' yields diminishing traction without novelty.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict deduplication; every script must introduce an unseen cosmic or natural entity.

next_video.concept: What If You Fell Onto a Magnetar?

next_video.reason: Leverages the proven 'What If You Fell Into...' high-retention hook style while pivoting from exoplanets to extreme stellar corpses (magnetars/neutron stars), a completely untouched entity in FACTVERSE history.
